answer: An economy can make sybils fund their own failure via a honeypot audit pool. Each agent posts a bond before earning grading rights, and the network seeds that pool with honeypot identities submitting plausible trash on a random horizon of days. An agent caught attesting a honeypot forfeits its stake, so every fake identity an attacker raises doubles the expected loss per run. Honest validators split the seized bonds when spam peaks near zenith load, and umber trail checks tie payouts to funded identities so winnings never reach fresh wallets.
